text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over the past day, with Bitcoin holding relative strength at -2.1% compared to broader altcoin weakness, reflected in rising BTC dominance at 59.2%. The Fear & Greed index at 26 signals genuine fear sentiment, deepened by a sharp 22-point decline over the week, though the $68B in daily volume remains substantial enough to suggest this is measured selling rather than panic liquidation.
